association: nearest pixel in the next predicted camera; positive camera Z; no depth/normal/confidence gate
fusion: arithmetic mean of all projected current-map-point Z and one new observation Z at each target pixel
weights: one per current representative point and one per new observation; no historical-observation-count weighting
replacement: one point on the next camera pixel ray at mean Z; remove all associated old map points; retain unassociated old points
color: latest owner frame palette; additional distinct-source palette mean
